subject: a 15th-century Korean Joseon king in his forties with a calm, thoughtful face and a short black beard and moustache, wearing a red silk royal robe with a gold dragon roundel on the chest and a black winged royal cap, a jade belt

panels.01-student: a studious teenage Korean prince in 1413 in a plain blue silk robe, reading thread-bound books by lamplight in a wooden palace study with paper screens, stacks of books around him, an elderly scholar-tutor in a black horsehair hat beside him, quiet focus, early Joseon Korea
panels.02-crowned: a young {S}, about twenty-one, seated on a raised throne in the throne hall of Gyeongbokgung Palace in 1418, a painted folding screen of the sun, moon and five peaks behind him, rows of officials in red and blue robes bowing, solemn and formal, Joseon Korea
panels.03-worthies: {S} sitting among young scholars in white and blue robes at low tables covered with books and brushes in a wooden hall of the palace in 1420, lively discussion, one scholar pointing to a page, autumn light through lattice doors, Joseon Korea
panels.04-clock: a Korean engineer in a simple official's robe adjusting a large bronze water clock with stacked vessels, pipes and small wooden figures that strike a bell and drum, in a palace pavilion in 1434, {S} watching with interest, careful craftsmanship, Joseon Korea
panels.05-raingauge: {S} and the young crown prince in a palace courtyard in 1441 inspecting a small iron cylinder rain gauge on a carved stone base after rain, an official kneeling to measure the water with a ruler, wet stone paving, clouds clearing, Joseon Korea
panels.06-letters: {S} at night alone in a lamplit study in 1443, bending over sheets of paper covered with simple geometric brush strokes, a small hand mirror beside him to watch the shape of his own mouth, ink stone and brushes, deep concentration, Joseon Korea, no readable text
panels.07-proclaim: {S} handing a newly printed thread-bound book to kneeling scholars in front of a palace hall in autumn 1446, officials in red and blue robes, maple leaves, woodblock printing tools on a nearby table, joyful and dignified, Joseon Korea, no readable text
panels.08-legacy: modern Korean schoolchildren in a bright museum hall looking at an old thread-bound book open in a glass case, sunlight, a tall bronze statue of a seated king visible through the window, hopeful mood, no readable text
